name: manifest_terminal
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
lane=Path.cwd();exclude=['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','manifest_terminal.receipt.json','manifest_terminal.output.txt']
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(lane)) not in exclude:
  files.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(lane)),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
d={'kind':'terminal actual SHA256 inventory, own lane only','mathdb_id':324571,'files':files,'terminal_self_exclusions':{'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'self hash circular','manifest_terminal.receipt.json':'runner writes after this child returns','manifest_terminal.output.txt':'runner writes after this child returns'},'all_completed_receipt_JSONs_included':[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('receipt.json')],'frozen_after':json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text()),'completed_jobs':'all earlier runner children synchronously reaped; this terminal job reaped by runner','no_later_frozen_writes':True,'credit':0,'formal_dispatch':False}
s=json.dumps(d,indent=2)
r=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
saved=json.loads(Path('SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_text());assert all(hashlib.sha256((lane/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256'] for x in saved['files'])
print(json.dumps({'files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'completed_receipts':len(d['all_completed_receipt_JSONs_included']),'frozen_after_bindings':d['frozen_after']['count'],'mismatches':[],'terminal_self_exclusions':exclude,'credit':0,'formal_dispatch':False}))
